seoTitle: Prompt Compressor: Cut Filler and Save Tokens
metaDescription: Shorten a prompt by removing politeness filler, wordy phrases, duplicate lines and extra whitespace, with the token saving and every change listed.
intro: Trim a long system prompt or instruction block without rewriting it by hand.
why:
A list of rules removes filler such as "please", "kindly" and "I would like you to", replaces wordy phrases ("in order to" becomes "to", "due to the fact that" becomes "because"), drops hedges like "basically" and "very", deletes trailing thank-yous, collapses whitespace and optionally removes duplicate lines. Each change is logged, and the character and estimated token counts before and after are shown (4 characters per token).

The rules are deliberately conservative, but meaning can still shift, so re-read the result and test the prompt. For real token counts use the tokenizer tools.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
